build.description: Default primary agent for full development, file editing, and task execution.

plan.description: Architectural analysis, SDD plan generation, and constraint definitions without editing files directly.

expert.description: High-reasoning specialist for complex refactoring, intricate bug fixes, and difficult multi-file tasks.

general.description: General-purpose subagent for background execution passes, multi-step subtasks, and SDD task reviews.

explore.description: Fast, read-only codebase search, file path inspection, and string matching.
